summary: Version 5 compiles, passes topology_check, and received a Critic review with score 0.95, must_repair=false, and no open issues. It draws the circle centred at O (radius 1.768 cm) with the triangle A–E–C–F–B, base A–D–B (drawn once), altitude C–O–H–D, and chord E–H–F. All eight labels A, B, C, D, E, F, H, O are bound to the measured points. No right-angle mark is drawn at D because the original and CV show none.
